Product Features

  • Measuring 170 x 40 x 40 cm, this TV stand is ideal for small living rooms without taking up too much space. This compact and exquisite TV stand will add a vintage touch to any living room.
  • Unique style: A fusion of natural aesthetics and luxury. The light wood colour interweaves with the central rattan accents, creating a visual eye-catcher that combines retro and modern elements. The rattan is made of high-strength plastic, which is breathable and durable. This avoids the wear and tear of traditional rattan and makes it easy to clean and maintain.
  • The embossed texture emphasizes the structure of the vertical stripes. The embossed sliding door design breaks the monotony of the flat surface and creates a sense of depth with three-dimensional lines. The rattan area creates a contrasting texture and gives the TV stand a striking artistic touch.
  • Optimal storage: Two drawers are perfect for storing small items such as remote controls and cables. The sliding door is suitable for storing books or decorative items, while the open drawer allows easy access to frequently used items.
  • The MDF base material is environmentally friendly and stable. The entire cabinet is made of high-density fiberboard (MDF), which is resistant to deformation and does not release formaldehyde. It meets environmental standards, is safe and reliable and fits into any living environment.
  • Unique Design: The oval tabletop not only looks elegant, but also prevents collisions and injuries. It is supported by eight legs, which provide stability and stability.
  • The cabinet has a total load capacity of up to 30 kg. It provides a secure hold for devices such as TVs and stereo systems. The oval tabletop has rounded edges for greater impact resistance. Its compact size makes it the perfect choice for a TV cabinet in the living room.
  • The smooth, matte surface is easy to clean; simply wipe with a cloth so that the TV cabinet always remains clean and tidy and you no longer have to worry about cleaning.
  • The sliding door design adds an interactive feel and transforms this piece of furniture from a boring piece of furniture into a practical piece of art that serves not only as a storage place but also as a decorative element in the living room.
  • Note: Due to different shooting conditions and the different display technology, there may be slight color deviations between the actual product and the picture. This is normal and does not pose a quality issue. Therefore, please order with caution.
